text:
maria: Quick pulse — we need to rotate authors for the next RFC review. Several folks in APAC can't make the 9am PT slot. Can we re-order so people with timezone constraints go earlier? Also proposing a tight agenda: 3m context / 8m Q&A / 4m decisions.

aj: I can swap with simeon if that helps. aj -> present on 5/4?

simeon: thanks aj — I'm on PTO 5/4-5/6 so can't present. if aj takes my slot that's perfect.

leo: +1 on swap. small ask: can we push pre-read reminder to 48h instead of 24h? reviewers sometimes need more time.

tara: agree 48h is better. i'll update the invite and preread checklist. also suggest adding a 2-min "blocking items" line in the agenda.

maria: New order proposal (compact):
```
- 09:00 PT: alice (infra rfc)
- 09:12 PT: aj (scheduling rfc)
- 09:24 PT: leo (kv cache)
- 09:36 PT: tara (rollout)
```
Keep total ~45 min. please ack or suggest swaps.

aj: ACK — swapping with simeon works for me. i'll add 2 slides with the open questions.

simeon: TY aj. i'll DM any context notes you might want.

calendar-bot: Updated invite: agenda tweaked + preread reminder set to 48 hours. calendar link: https://calendar/ev/12345

maria: tara — can you post the preread snippet in the RFC doc and tag reviewers @leo @aj @simeon?

tara: done. Preread checklist added to doc: short summary, test plan, perf numbers + what to look for. i'll post a reminder 48h before.

leo: will review and leave inline comments. :thumbsup:

maria: Great — closing this thread unless anyone has last-minute conflicts. DM me otherwise. Thanks!
